title: OpenSEO launches open-source SEO tool with real data and self-hosting #OpenSEO #SEOtools #aidata
description: OpenSEO launched a free, fully open-source alternative to expensive SEO tools like RFs and SEMrush. Built out of frustration with high prices and bloated features, OpenSEO offers real SEO data through an MCP that enables accurate keyword research, competitor analysis, backlink tracking, and integration with Google Search Console. Unlike AI tools that guess keywords without proper data, OpenSEO delivers reliable metrics that prevent hallucinated SEO advice. Its self-hosting capability empowers users with full control and transparency, making it a strong contender in the evolving SEO software market. This innovation challenges traditional paid tools by democratizing access to professional-grade SEO analytics, reducing costs, and increasing accuracy for marketers and businesses. #OpenSEO #SEOtools #SEOanalytics #KeywordResearch #BacklinkAnalysis #SearchConsoleIntegration #OpenSourceSEO #MCP #SEMSrushAlternative #SEOsoftware #DigitalMarketingTools #SelfHosting #AIdrivenSEO #MarketingInnovation #SEOdata
